_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Oil Discharge Report
summary: This report details all relevant facts concerning any oil discharge from vessels being constructed under contract, including cause and circumstances.
description_purpose: This report is designed to detail all relevant facts concerning any oil discharge from the vessel(s) being constructed hereunder, whether or not caused by the contractor's negligence, or by (1) an act of God, (2) act of war (3) act of negligence on the part of the Government, or (4) an act of a third party whether or not such act was not negligent, or any other combination of these causes.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the content and format preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
7.2 A copy of the reference document cited below may be obtained as specified in the contract.
7.3 This DID supersedes UD1-A-23041.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Document
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including its approval date and dates of any applicable revisions and changes, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: General
preparation_instructions.content: Although it is desired that this report be concise, sufficient detail is desired. Vague descriptions and indications of "unknown" are not acceptable unless the Contractor can show to the satisfaction of the Supervisor that such descriptions and indications are not susceptible to more detailed definition. Except where impossible, the data in this report shall be from the result of an "on-site" review.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Oil Discharge Report shall be prepared in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be as specified in OPNAVINST 5090.1 Appendix entitled "Oil Spill Message Format" and shall also include the following:

children.title: Type of discharge (at sea, in port, ashore).
Date, time, and location of discharge
children.content: (for at-sea discharge, specify latitude and longitude at the beginning and end of the incident).

children.title: Type of ship, vessel, craft, or facility involved.
Nature and quantity of oil discharged
children.content: ("oil" is defined to include gasoline and jet fuels).

children.title: Weather conditions at time of discharge
Major and Minor collisions
children.content: with identification of object collided with

children.title: Human error
children.content: (give details except personnel identification not desired)

children.title: Handling of oily wastes in donuts
Corrective measures recommended to prevent a future discharge of this nature
